name: milvus
description: Use the Milvus vector database (self-hosted Milvus, Zilliz Cloud, or Milvus Lite) from the agent: manage collections, insert data, run vector, full-text (BM25) and hybrid search, build RAG knowledge bases and agent memory. Wraps zilliztech/mcp-server-milvus and adds task skills plus two script toolkits: a knowledge-base toolkit (document ingest with Ollama/OpenAI-compatible embeddings, hybrid search, cited answers) and a guarded ops toolkit (health, metrics, indexes, partitions, compaction; dry-run by default).

MILVUS_URI.title: Milvus URI
MILVUS_URI.description: Milvus endpoint. Standalone/cluster: http://localhost:19530. Zilliz Cloud: your cluster's public endpoint (https://...zillizcloud.com). Milvus Lite (macOS/Linux only): an absolute path to a local .db file, e.g. /path/to/milvus_demo.db.

MILVUS_TOKEN.title: Milvus token (secret)
MILVUS_TOKEN.description: Optional. Zilliz Cloud API key, or 'username:password' for a Milvus instance with authentication enabled (e.g. root:Milvus). Leave empty for local Milvus without auth or Milvus Lite.

MILVUS_DB.title: Database name
MILVUS_DB.description: Optional. Milvus database to use. Defaults to 'default'.
